ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the lower left of the figure, an R group is connected to a central carbon; this central carbon is connected rightward to a two-carbon chain, whose terminus is O-H, namely -CH2-CH2-OH; the central carbon is connected upward to an oxygen atom, and this oxygen is further connected to a positively charged CH2 unit; in the figure this upper carbon is connected to two H and is labeled with a positive charge. There is also a curved arrow in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrow. Reasoning: According to the specified method, represent R with the wildcard atom * and connect it to the central carbon; from this central carbon write a branch CCO to represent the two-carbon alcohol chain; the other side is connected through oxygen to the positively charged methylene [CH2+]. Therefore the linearized SMILES is *C(CCO)O[CH2+].

method.method_draft: Convert the skeletal drawing into a connectivity graph: replace R with '*' attached to the central carbon; from that carbon include one branch to the two-carbon alcohol chain, CCO, and one bond through oxygen to the positively charged CH2 group. Linearize this graph as *C(CCO)O[CH2+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左下有一个 R 基团连接到一个中心碳；该中心碳向右连接一条两碳链，末端是 O-H，即 -CH2-CH2-OH；中心碳向上连接一个氧原子，该氧再连接到一个带正电的 CH2 单元，图中该上方碳连有两个 H 并标有正电荷。图中还有一条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按指定方法把 R 用通配原子 * 表示，并与中心碳相连；从该中心碳写出一个支链 CCO 表示两碳醇链；另一侧通过氧连接到带正电的亚甲基 [CH2+]。因此线性化的 SMILES 为 *C(CCO)O[CH2+]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct graph-to-SMILES transcription from the displayed skeletal structure; this is the natural single route for this image-only structure identification task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecule in the image while ignoring the curved arrows: an R group is attached to a central carbon, that carbon is bonded upward to an oxygen, and along a two-carbon chain to a terminal OH; the upper oxygen is bonded to a methylene bearing two hydrogens and a positive charge.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: represent the unspecified R attachment as wildcard '*', write branches with parentheses, encode oxygen as O, and encode the positively charged methylene as [CH2+]. Preserve only atom connectivity, not reaction arrows.
